description: sira.arpat.toscana.it: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sira.arpat.toscana.it. Coverage: the area served by sira.arpat.toscana.it. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Linee elettriche ad alta e altissima tensione; Misure brevi del campo magnetico in prossimita' di linee elettriche ad; Misure lunghe del campo magnetico in prossimita' delle linee elettrich; Officine di trasformazione (linee elettriche ad alta e altissima tensi. Formats seen: WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
